result: Per-call model.tools diagnostic loaded actual MCP catalog; production repair and requalification still required
scope: Actual Vapi diagnostic with a temporary local REST gateway that deliberately changed the per-call override placement; this is not a pass of the unmodified installed candidate
observations: Unmodified tools:append voice override exposes connectTools itself to the model; no tools/list occurs even with successful private verification and MCP initialize.
With the same MCP entry placed under a preserved saved-assistant model.tools, Vapi fetches tools/list during call setup before returning the call receipt.
The queued call resource already exists, carries the nonce and passes existing strict private API verification. No weakened lifecycle or authority check is needed.
